methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date (2026-06-13); CDN is billed either as a flat monthly plan or as usage-based bandwidth, so monthlyUsd holds the flat plan price where one exists and otherwise the published monthly minimum (or null when there is none), with the per-GB/per-TB rates and any volume tiers recorded in notes. Quote-only/Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null; HIPAA/BAA and minutes/calls/overage fields do not apply to CDN bandwidth and are null for every tier. Every figure is sourced to the fetched pricing page.

vendors.name: Cloudflare
vendors.provenance: https://www.cloudflare.com/plans/ (official plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat per-domain monthly plans with CDN included, prices shown for both annual and monthly billing)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever: unmetered CDN, unmetered DDoS protection, fast DNS, Universal SSL, free managed WAF ruleset, single sign-on and role-based account control.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: All Free features plus lossless image optimization and AMP; $25/mo billed monthly or $20/mo billed annually (~20% off).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: All Pro features plus PCI DSS 4.0 compliance and a 100% uptime SLA with 1x service credits; $250/mo billed monthly or $200/mo billed annually (~20% off).

plans.name: Enterprise (Contract)
plans.notes: Custom annual contract: all Business features plus 10x-25x uptime service credits and network prioritization. Quote-only.

vendors.name: Bunny.net
vendors.provenance: https://bunny.net/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; usage-based bandwidth-only pricing, no per-request fees, $1 monthly minimum)

plans.name: Standard Network (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: 119-PoP network, region-based per-GB bandwidth: Europe & North America $0.01/GB, Asia & Oceania $0.03/GB, South America $0.045/GB, Middle East & Africa $0.06/GB. No request fees. monthlyUsd reflects the $1 monthly minimum; 14-day free trial, no card required.

plans.name: Volume Network (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: 10-PoP global volume network with tiered per-GB rates: first 500 TB $0.005/GB, 500 TB-1 PB $0.004/GB, 1 PB-2 PB $0.002/GB, 2 PB+ contact sales. No request fees. monthlyUsd reflects the $1 monthly minimum.

vendors.name: Fastly
vendors.provenance: https://www.fastly.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat Network Services packages plus separate usage-based Full Site Delivery CDN pricing)

plans.name: Full Site Delivery (usage-based CDN)
plans.notes: Pure usage-based CDN with no fixed monthly fee: first 100 GB/region/mo free, then $0.08-$0.28/GB (varies by region) for 100 GB-10 TB and $0.08-$0.24/GB for the next 10 TB. Requests: first 1M/mo free, then $0.01 per 10,000 (1M-100M) and $0.0095 per 10,000 beyond 100M. monthlyUsd null (no fixed plan fee).

plans.name: Network Services - Basic
plans.notes: Flat package including 100M requests/month, 20 TLS domains and 30M Image Optimizer requests.

plans.name: Network Services - Starter
plans.notes: Flat package including 500M requests/month, 40 TLS domains and 150M Image Optimizer requests.

plans.name: Network Services - Advantage & Ultimate
plans.notes: Higher-volume network services packages; custom pricing, contact sales. Quote-only.

vendors.name: Amazon CloudFront
vendors.provenance: https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/ and https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/pay-as-you-go/ (official pricing pages, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans plus an always-free tier and pay-as-you-go per-GB/per-request rates)

plans.name: Free (Always Free + flat plan)
plans.notes: Always-free tier: 1 TB of data transfer out to the internet per month and 10,000,000 HTTP/HTTPS requests per month, free.

plans.name: Pro (flat plan)
plans.notes: Flat-rate plan per distribution bundling the CloudFront CDN with multiple AWS services and feature allowances, with no overage charges.

plans.name: Business (flat plan)
plans.notes: Flat-rate plan per distribution with higher bundled usage allowances and no overage charges.

plans.name: Premium (flat plan)
plans.notes: Top flat-rate plan per distribution with the largest bundled allowances and no overage charges.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (on-demand)
plans.notes: On-demand usage with no fixed fee: after the 1 TB always-free allowance, data transfer out is $0.085/GB for the next 9 TB in both US/Mexico/Canada and Europe/Israel/Turkiye. Requests (after first 10M free): US/Mexico/Canada $0.0075 per 10k HTTP and $0.0100 per 10k HTTPS; Europe/Israel/Turkiye $0.0090 per 10k HTTP and $0.0120 per 10k HTTPS. monthlyUsd null (no fixed plan fee).

vendors.name: KeyCDN
vendors.provenance: https://www.keycdn.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; usage-based per-GB bandwidth with regional tiers, $4 monthly minimum, no request charges)

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (bandwidth)
plans.notes: Tiered per-GB bandwidth. North America & Europe: $0.04/GB first 10 TB, $0.03 next 40 TB, $0.02 next 50 TB, $0.01 over 100 TB. Asia & Oceania: $0.08/$0.06/$0.04/$0.02. Africa & Latin America: $0.10/$0.08/$0.06/$0.04. No request charges; free TLS certs; first 3 zones free then $1/zone/mo. monthlyUsd reflects the $4 monthly minimum usage (minimum payment $49).

plans.name: Storage (Push Zones)
plans.notes: Optional origin storage add-on: $0.12/GB first 500 GB/mo, $0.08/GB next 500 GB, $0.04/GB above 1 TB. Log forwarding $1/day; image processing $0.40 per 1,000 operations. monthlyUsd null (usage add-on, no fixed fee).

vendors.name: CDN77
vendors.provenance: https://www.cdn77.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; one published fixed plan plus a quote-only enterprise tier and an object-storage add-on)

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Fixed plan including up to 250 TB monthly traffic (effectively ~$3.96/TB), with $3.96/TB overage; global coverage, all features and 24/7 support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom traffic volume and features, dedicated account specialist and direct L2/L3 engineer access. Tailored (quote-only) price.

plans.name: Object Storage (add-on)
plans.notes: Optional add-on: $100/mo for 5 TB HDD storage ($0.02/GB); API requests $0.03 per 10k (first 1M free); egress $0.09/GB (first 50 GB free).

vendors.name: CDNsun
vendors.provenance: https://www.cdnsun.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; pay-as-you-go per-GB bandwidth with no per-request charges, $0 minimum on the Business plan)

plans.name: Business (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Per-GB bandwidth: Europe & North America $0.030/GB; APAC, South America & Africa $0.060/GB. Unlimited requests, CDN storage (5 GB free), SSL, API, HTTP/2, streaming, raw logs, DDoS protection and 100% SLA included at no extra charge. $0 minimum monthly spend; prepaid credit valid one year; 15-day free trial.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Custom plan with a $200 minimum monthly spend; bespoke rates negotiated with sales. monthlyUsd null (quote-only rate; $200 is a spend floor not a plan fee).

vendors.name: BlazingCDN
vendors.provenance: https://blazingcdn.com/en-us/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; usage-based per-TB volume tiers with a $25 monthly minimum and a quote-only enterprise tier)

plans.name: FLEX CDN (static, pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Progressive per-TB volume tiers for static content: 0-5 TB $5.00/TB, 5-25 TB $4.50/TB, 25-100 TB $4.00/TB, 100-500 TB $3.50/TB, 500-1000 TB $3.00/TB, 1000-1500 TB $2.50/TB. 14-day free trial (1 GB free, then $5/TB). monthlyUsd reflects the $25 monthly minimum.

plans.name: Video CDN (VoD, pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Same per-TB traffic tiers as FLEX (extending to 2000+ TB at $2.00/TB) plus permanent cache: 500 GB free then $0.02/GB. Cloud storage $0.025/GB; raw logs $50 one-time. monthlyUsd reflects the $25 monthly minimum.

plans.name: Enterprise X
plans.notes: For 1000+ TB/month with up to ~60% discount via custom quote. Quote-only.
